description: The SandboxAPIs MCP server: read-only, API-compatible replicas of 21 developer APIs, preloaded with one simulated company, for testing agents without a test account.
rules: Call the orient tool first; it returns every base URL, the pinned hosts and the remaining request budget.
Every host is read-only. A write returns the provider's own error shape naming what was attempted.
For CI and evals, use a pinned snapshot host, never the live host: the live data set re-rolls daily.
Anonymous callers get 60 requests an hour per address; set SANDBOXAPIS_API_KEY for 600.
